package datatable

import "github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"

type RouteOption[M any] struct{}

func ReadAccess[M any](...http.GuardOption[M]) RouteOption[M]   { return RouteOption[M]{} }
func ExportAccess[M any](...http.GuardOption[M]) RouteOption[M] { return RouteOption[M]{} }

type Table struct{}
type Config[M any] struct{}

func Routes[M any](http.Scope, Table, Config[M], ...RouteOption[M]) error { return nil }
